name: 📱UPDATE📱Texting Simulator 💬
desc:
Prepare your thumbs to start your 💬 adventure with a brand new Ancient Rokia Phone and upgrade your way up to the latest in smartphone technology!

HOW TO PLAY:
1. Click to send text messages by using your phone!
2. Sell your texts for money in the tower.
3. Buy and upgrade your device, hatch pets, and more!

🛎️Experience contains paid sponsor content.

A game by Shark Fin Studios, LLC.
